SELECT count(*) AS count_1 
FROM (SELECT cards.public_id AS public_id, cards.set_id AS set_id, cards.card_number AS card_number, cards.name AS name, cards.subtitle AS subtitle, cards.card_type AS card_type, cards.rarity AS rarity, cards.chakra AS chakra, cards.power AS power, cards.faction AS faction, cards.ability_text AS ability_text, cards.flavor_text AS flavor_text, cards.artist AS artist, cards.id AS id, cards.created_at AS created_at, cards.updated_at AS updated_at 
FROM cards JOIN sets ON sets.id = cards.set_id 
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM keywords, card_keywords 
WHERE cards.id = card_keywords.card_id AND keywords.id = card_keywords.keyword_id AND lower(keywords.slug) = %(lower_1)s::VARCHAR)) AS anon_1

SELECT sets.public_id, sets.code, sets.name, sets.edition, sets.language, sets.release_date, sets.printed_total, sets.total_with_variants, sets.logo_url, sets.symbol_url, sets.id, sets.created_at, sets.updated_at, cards.public_id AS public_id_1, cards.set_id, cards.card_number, cards.name AS name_1, cards.subtitle, cards.card_type, cards.rarity, cards.chakra, cards.power, cards.faction, cards.ability_text, cards.flavor_text, cards.artist, cards.id AS id_1, cards.created_at AS created_at_1, cards.updated_at AS updated_at_1 
FROM cards JOIN sets ON sets.id = cards.set_id 
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM keywords, card_keywords 
WHERE cards.id = card_keywords.card_id AND keywords.id = card_keywords.keyword_id AND lower(keywords.slug) = %(lower_1)s::VARCHAR) ORDER BY cards.card_number ASC NULLS LAST, cards.public_id ASC 
 LIMIT %(param_1)s::INTEGER OFFSET %(param_2)s::INTEGER

SELECT card_images.card_id AS card_images_card_id, card_images.variant_id AS card_images_variant_id, card_images.image_type AS card_images_image_type, card_images.url AS card_images_url, card_images.source_name AS card_images_source_name, card_images.source_url AS card_images_source_url, card_images.hosted_by_us AS card_images_hosted_by_us, card_images.width AS card_images_width, card_images.height AS card_images_height, card_images.created_at AS card_images_created_at, card_images.id AS card_images_id

WHERE card_images.card_id IN (%(primary_keys_1)s::UUID, %(primary_keys_2)s::UUID, %(primary_keys_3)s::UUID) AND card_images.variant_id IS NULL
